class.name: TextInsertionValues
class.brief_description: A set of named values for the placeholders of [TextInsertionServer].

method.name: get_value
method.description: Returns the value for [param name], or [param default] if there is none.

method.name: has_value
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if a value for [param name] exists.

method.name: remove_value
method.description: Removes the value for [param name] and emits [signal Resource.changed].

method.name: set_value
method.description: Sets the value for [param name] and emits [signal Resource.changed].

members.member: The order among the resources added to [TextInsertionServer]: a higher priority is asked first. With equal priority, the resource added later wins.
The values by name. [String] keys are converted to [StringName]. [b]Note:[/b] The returned dictionary is a copy. Use [method set_value] or assign a whole dictionary to change the values.
